Your holdings: SOXL (-34.89%) and SPAL (-34.29%) need immediate attention. Both are leveraged ETFs, which decay over time and amplify losses, especially on margin. Your default stop for SOXL is far off, indicating it needs adjustment.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, losing positions, and be cautious with new longs given macro headwinds.
